notes:
## New features

- None in this release.

## Changes

**Known issue — interpolated raster and SmartSmooth can fail**

The reported “Cell-clipped constrained support is not a valid face cover” error remains unresolved. It can prevent interpolated raster and SmartSmooth generation in affected scenes. This release does not claim that contours are fully fixed.

**Verification scope**

Release acceptance is limited to the packaged app launching as 0.10.2, opening a disposable project, basic acoustic calculation and raw-grid display, save/reopen, and installer/update integrity. These checks do not establish standards compliance.

The original regression run collected 4,099 tests: 4,091 passed, three skipped/xfail, and one test-module process crashed before reporting its five case results. Those five cases therefore have no completed results in that run. The same five popup-lifetime cases passed separately on native Cocoa; this does not erase the original offscreen crash or constitute a clean full-suite pass. No other modules were left unrun.


- Retained the compact, rounded AURIS hover-help styling introduced in v0.10.1, including after map/WebEngine startup.
- P1999's ISO 9613-2 shadow-boundary calculation remains unchanged. Its sharp numerical transition is a feature of the engineering prediction method for this geometry, not a physically discontinuous real-world sound field. No cosmetic smoothing has been applied.


## Bug fixes

- Update the production runtime to Python 3.14.7 and PySide6/Qt 6.11.2, with exact dependency pins for reproducible builds, resolving the sheet-text export crash seen on the previous runtime.
- Opening saved projects and recovering autosaves no longer rebuild uncached SmartSmooth contours on the UI thread. The solved acoustic grid is displayed while contour presentation is restored in the background.
- Sped up SmartSmooth screening-transition validation by reusing immutable building geometry across receiver probes. Acoustic results and contour geometry remain unchanged.
- Fixed slow sheet-preview pan and zoom caused by rescanning logo pixels in Python on every frame. Preview refreshes are coalesced during gestures, followed by the full-resolution settled render.
- Contour progress now identifies screening-transition discovery, domain partitioning, interpolation and geometry processing as they happen. Completed receiver batches hand back to an indeterminate working state while further work remains.
- Footer labels name the active operation once and remove repeated “Working” text. Measured work retains stage percentages and throughput-based ETA; elapsed time is no longer labelled as remaining time. Final completion is shown only when the result is available.
- The footer progress fill now advances with the measured stage percentage. Unknown work uses a short moving indicator instead of a misleading full-width shimmer.
- Removed full planning-report/source audits from frequent footer refreshes, preventing repeated UI stalls during contour generation. Live error and warning counts remain available; full report assessments are unchanged.
- Project-file compression and atomic writing now run off-thread from a detached snapshot. The UI keeps repainting during save, write failures remain visible, and changes arriving during the write remain marked unsaved.

- SmartSmooth traces the shared 16× interpolated scalar field before vectorisation, simplification and Bézier shaping. Spacing-aware shared tangents remove scalloping from unevenly spaced anchors while preserving categorical ISO shadow boundaries.
- Fixed a threshold-endpoint reconstruction error that could introduce a backtracking spike in a narrow raw contour face. Shared geometry caches are versioned to discard the old presentation.
- Prepared polygon indexing accelerates dense-model contour ownership checks while preserving exact boundary semantics.
- Receptor Results and Calculate all scenarios retain scenario identities, agree with individual calculations, and preserve clipboard/Excel identities and saved results.

Runtime: Python 3.14.7; PySide6, Shiboken6 and Qt 6.11.2. Production and build dependencies are frozen exactly. The selected direct dependencies were checked against stable upstream releases on 24 September 2026. The only non-latest resolved transitive dependency is pydantic_core 2.46.5, required exactly by pydantic 2.13.5.
- Changing contour intervals, level ranges or band counts now rebuilds vectors from the saved interpolated field without recalculating screening transitions. Band controls support up to 64 bands, including 1 dB intervals over a 40 dB range; completed layouts are cached for quick reuse.
- Reuse fixed screening-boundary geometry during SmartSmooth curve validation, reducing repeated geometry work without changing acoustic values or contour tolerances.
